units.source_text: 谁知，狗挪开了视线低下头，像什么事也没发生过似的慢吞吞离开了。

en.t: But then the dog turned its eyes away, lowered its head, and slowly walked off as if nothing had happened.
It seemed I had managed to frighten it after all.

units.source_text: 眼睛紧盯着野狗也会令它折服，足见我还是有点气魄的。

en.t: If staring down a stray dog could make it submit, then I must still have a little force of spirit left in me.

units.source_text: 他“哧溜”一下滑进坑中，就那样背靠着斜坡。

en.t: He slipped down into the pit with a quick slide and stayed there with his back against the slope.

units.source_text: 也许因为挡住了风，他忽地感到呼吸顺畅多了。

en.t: Perhaps because the wind was blocked, he suddenly felt it was much easier to breathe.

units.source_text: 狗在风中一脚高一脚低地走着，不一会儿就消失在飞沙的那一头。

en.t: The dog stumbled along unevenly in the wind and before long vanished beyond the blowing sand.

units.source_text: 这既然是野狗找的落脚处，就能保证人们不会接近吧……

en.t: Since this was a resting place found by a stray dog, surely that meant people would not come near it...

units.source_text: 只要那条狗不到农协的事务所去报告，这里暂时是安全的。

en.t: As long as that dog did not go report to the agricultural cooperative office, this place would be safe for the time being.

units.source_text: 连缓缓渗出的汗水，也使人感到心里舒坦。

en.t: Even the sweat slowly seeping out made him feel at ease inside.

units.source_text: 简直像被封在橡胶底部似的……

en.t: It was almost as if he had been sealed beneath a layer of rubber...

units.source_text: 他就像抱着一个不知何时会爆炸的定时炸弹，却没去注意定时器上嘀嗒嘀嗒钟摆的声音……

en.t: It was as if he were holding a time bomb that might explode at any moment, yet paying no attention to the ticktock of the pendulum in its timer...

units.source_text: 假如是那个麦比乌斯圈，他会当场分析情况，振振有词：

en.t: If it had been that Mobius strip, he would have analyzed the situation on the spot and declared with perfect confidence:
